daycontents: Another day, another box: the lunar new year is getting closer and closer!
Chinese New Year is also called the Spring Festival: it marks the passage to a new season.
Before the festival it is a tradition to clean the house, to make room for the good luck of the new year.
Red is the colour of the festival: it brings good luck and keeps bad influences away.
Red lanterns decorate streets and homes in the days before the new year.
Red envelopes with a small gift are one of the most typical gestures of the festival.
Dumplings, a symbol of prosperity, are among the most loved dishes of the festival.
Each year is associated with one of the twelve animals of the Chinese zodiac: do you know yours?
Strips of red paper with handwritten wishes decorate the doors of the houses.
The New Year's Eve dinner brings the whole family together: it is the most awaited moment of the festival.
Fireworks and drums announce the arrival of the new year.
The lion dance and the dragon dance bring joy and good fortune to the streets.
A sincere wish to someone you care about is the best way to get ready for the new year.
The lunar new year is getting closer: keep up the countdown!

daycontent_last: Happy New Year! The lunar new year has arrived: may it bring you health, serenity and prosperity. Best wishes to you and your loved ones!
